title: Debiaser Beware: Pitfalls of Centering Regularized Transport Maps
tldr_zh: Sinkhorn map T^D_ε=T_ε+∇α_ε 在 ε→0 时不比 entropic map 差（Gaussian 下 O(ε⁴) vs O(ε²)），但 ε 大或样本少时可被任意倍劣化
tldr_en: Debiased Sinkhorn map matches the entropic map as epsilon to 0 (O(eps^4) vs O(eps^2) for Gaussians) but can be arbitrarily worse for large epsilon or small samples.
key_numbers: Theorem 3: as eps -> inf, R(T_eps) -> Var(Q) while R(T^D_eps) -> W_2^2(P_centered, Q_centered); neither dominates
Theorem 4: for any eps < 1 and M > 0 there exist (P_eps, Q_eps) with R(T^D_eps) >= M R(T_eps)
Gaussian case: ||T_eps - T_0||^2 <= (eps^2/4) Tr(A^{-1}) + O(eps^4) (Theorem 5) vs ||T^D_eps - T_0||^2 <~ eps^4 (Theorem 6)
Finite samples: in d=15 with concentrated target, Sinkhorn map worse than entropic map for all eps <= 1 (Fig. 5b); on single-cell day0->day1 (d=30) entropic map wins for small eps (Fig. 6)
